def find_pairs(n):
    # Generate all possible pairs of elements from the set {1, 2, ..., n}
    pairs = list(itertools.combinations(range(1, n+1), 2))

        # Check if the sum is not already in the set and does not exceed n

            # Add the sum to the set
            pair_sums.add(pair_sum)
            
            # Add the pair to the list of disjoint pairs
            disjoint_pairs.append(pair)
    
    # Return the list of disjoint pairs
    return disjoint_pairs
